content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently updated my [product_name] software from [version_no] 8.0 to [version_no] 8.2. After opening a program file that was shared with me, the view shifted to the right and I cannot see the end of the branch. How can I resolve this issue?
Please upload the program as a zipped file so we can review it.
Hi, try expanding the working area on the page. As another user suggested, providing a screenshot or uploading the file would be helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a display issue after updating their [product_name] software from version 8.0 to 8.2. Program branches within the visual interface are shifted, and the end of a branch is not visible. This points to a possible regression or compatibility issue with how older project files are shown in the new software version, impacting program navigation and readability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates smooth compatibility and consistent display across software updates, expecting to be able to view and edit program files from colleagues without encountering visual or functional issues.
